confessions: feat(release): fix deft-directive-release gaps found in the 0.129.1 cut
Fail-closed release-skill closeout and channel residue from the 0.129.1 cut; Gap 7 deferred to #5953; make_latest deferred to #5852.
Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6430642914: provenance-gated pin+deposit, channel verify, skip-CI ledger, Unreleased sentinel promote, Publish-job success, e2e cleanup.
Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/5954

- relieves: P1 — Add `task release:pin -- <V>` that opens `chore: pin Directive to <V>` with regenerated lockfile and writes AgeExclude only after provenance (artifact sha512 + attestation source commit equals peeled tag) passes.

- relieves: P1 — Fail Skill Completion closed until that pin PR URL exists and the version-matched `directive upgrade --target-version <V>` deposit evidence exists on the same PR or a named companion PR.

- relieves: P2 — Fail-closed Phase 7 channel verify for npm `maintainer=<V>` / unchanged `latest` plus sha512/provenance baselines captured before publish (`#5852` owns GitHub `make_latest` / `--latest=false` / promote-latest; retracted from this file_scope).
- relieves: P3 — Compose the skip-CI spend into in-memory promote and write it at Step 7 with a literal `allow-skip-ci=#N` formatter/parser pair.
- relieves: P3 — Make unpaid-ledger validation version-aware so same-version section citations do not refuse an aborted-cut resume of the same cut.
- relieves: P3 — On the production skip path, resolve and validate cut-SHA GHA coverage-of-record before artifact prep so notes carry that cite.
- relieves: P4 — Seed `FRESH_UNRELEASED_BLOCK` with a typed sentinel that `extractUnreleasedDashEntries` excludes from ordinary entry counts and that `promoteChangelog` strips on promote.

- relieves: P4 — Add a verified release-promotion success path in the changelog gate that accepts sentinel-only Unreleased only for the actual promote transition, refuses ordinary changes that inherit sentinel-only Unreleased, and never copies the sentinel into release notes.
- relieves: P5 — Require Phase 5 success of the Publish job and both publish steps, with fixture-job red cited as leftover `#5603`.
- relieves: P6 — Add `release:e2e:cleanup --list` that writes exact repo/dir ids to a file and `--confirm` that deletes only those ids on operator TTY.
- relieves: P6 — Wrap two-pass `deft-4271-two-pass-*` creation in try/finally like rehearsal, and print leftover list at Skill Completion.
- relieves: P6 — Add aborted-cut resume that reconciles existing tag/release/both package versions before reuse, and Anti-Pattern `materialize:runtime` in the cut tree.
- relieves: P6 — Add channel-aware maintainer banner template plus structured `--known-issue` / `--deferred` inputs.
